text:
Alex K: getting hit with a pile of pending GPU pods in us-west-2, ~30 pods stuck with FailedScheduling.
Alex K: kubectl describe snippet:
```
Events:
  Type     Reason            Age                 From               Message
  ----     ------            ----                ----               -------
  Warning  FailedScheduling  2m (x18 over 12m)  default-scheduler  0/25 nodes are available: 25 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu.
```
Maria L: are those pods requesting fractional GPUs or whole ints?
Alex K: fractional (0.5/0.25) — older batch job configs. We never enabled sharing in this cluster.
Jun W: k8s treats GPU as integer during binpacking so those count as 1 for placement checks, leading to fragmentation on 8/4-GPU hosts. autoscaler should add nodes though?
InfraBot: Autoscaler: scale-up inhibited due to recent failed scale-up in us-west-2. See /ops/autoscaler/us-west-2/logs.
Ops Oncall: we're seeing a bunch of Pending and also a couple of new nodes stuck in NotReady after the CNI restart last night. that delayed kubelet registration for ~4 nodes which reduced capacity temporarily.
Sam T: NotReady nodes + fractional requests = bad combo. Two immediate mitigations: 1) mutating webhook that normalizes requests <1 to 1 (fast, but wastes GPUs), 2) task-queue to aggregate small jobs into a single GPU runner.
Maria L: can we let the autoscaler start smaller instance types? launching 4-GPU nodes for short bursts would pack these 0.5 reqs better and cost less than overprovisioning 8-GPU machines.
Ops Oncall: autoscaler attempted scale up 18m ago but AWS GPU instance quota was hit. I opened ticket #AWS-4532. AWS increased quota for some families but not all — waiting on final confirmation for p4d and g5. ETA ~35m.
Alex K: I just kicked off a manual nodepool scale to add two 4-gpu instances from the spare account (on-call workaround) but they came up on spot and got interrupted once — we lost one node, so pending count only dropped a bit.
Jun W: spot preemptions will worsen packing churn. For short term maybe allow OnDemand for the 4-gpu pool until quota stabilizes. Ops, can you make that change?
Ops Oncall: done, switched two nodes to OnDemand in us-west-2-group-b. cost impact small for now — we need reliability.
Sam T: also noticed kernel-driver probes on the new nodes are slower when CNI rollout is happening; the node register delay makes the autoscaler think capacity is unavailable and inhibits additional scale attempts. we should bump node registration timeout in autoscaler config.
Maria L: good point. let's add a 2-minute grace for node registration and lower scaleUpDelay from 5m to 90s for this pool so it responds faster to bursts. PR incoming.
Alex K: long term: we should enable A100 MIG slicing for model trainers that can use fractional slices and adopt a vGPU scheduler plugin for user-facing jobs. MIG needs special node images and driver rebuilds though.
Jun W: agree. MIG would let us slice 1 A100 into multiple 0.25/0.5 slices and reduce fragmentation. downside: not all workloads are MIG-friendly. We'll need a migration plan.
Sam T: I'll draft a proposal: (1) enable MIG on a separate nodepool, (2) provide a user-facing annotation to choose MIG vs full-GPU, (3) onboarding docs + admission webhook to prevent fractional raw nvidia.com/gpu requests unless the pod has the MIG annotation.
InfraBot: Note: cost estimate for OnDemand fallback for 2x g4dn/4x g5 temporary pool ~+$12k/month if sustained.
Maria L: callout: add a metric/alert for fractional-gpu requests submission rate across clusters, and a dashboard showing fragmentation ratio (wasted GPUs/total GPUs). We had 18% fragmentation this window.
Ops Oncall: AWS quota updated for g5 family, p4 still pending. as soon as p4 confirmed we'll prefer p4 for large trainer pools.
Alex K: thanks. I'll roll the webhook to prod if quota doesn't resolve in 40m. For now, tracking in this thread. will post when pending pods drain.
Sam T: opening the PR for alerts and docs now.
Maria L: nice work. also let's add a blurb to the runbook: "If PendingInsufficientGPU spikes, check quota, CNI node readiness, and fractional requests."
Jun W: can someone add a quick note to the infra calendar to schedule the MIG nodepool rollout test next week?
Alex K: yep, added calendar invite. closing loop when pods are green. :thumbsup:
